problem.summary: Large accumulated chat context with many local files caused noticeable UI/runtime lag.
primaryCauses: Conversation history restoration could inject many local attachment/artifact references into model-visible context.
Frontend context-size estimation scanned every attachment, step, and legacy tool call for retained messages.

changes: Bound recovered local attachment/artifact references to 4 per message and 40 per loaded context.
Deduplicate recovered references by normalized label/path.
Truncate restored paths to 512 characters and artifact titles to 160 characters.
Append a compact omitted-reference summary when duplicates or over-budget entries are skipped.
Bound context-size estimation to the first 8 files per message/draft.
Truncate file keys used by context-size estimation to 240 characters.
Bound context-size estimation to the first 16 steps and first 12 legacy tool calls per message.
Add bounded omitted-cost approximations so the meter remains conservative without scanning unbounded arrays.

privacy.publicArtifactPolicy: No raw file paths are included in this artifact.
privacy.modelContextPolicy: Local paths may be restored into model-visible context for task continuity, but are deduplicated, truncated, and budgeted.
